name: campus-library-api
one_liner: A FastAPI + SQLite REST API for a college library: students sign up, search books, borrow and return them; librarians manage inventory.
readme_claims: Scalable to thousands of concurrent students
Prevents double-borrowing of the same copy
Fine is calculated automatically for late returns

key_files.purpose: Opens SQLite connections and creates tables on startup.
key_files.snippet:
DB_PATH = 'library.db'

def get_connection():
    conn = sqlite3.connect(DB_PATH)
    conn.row_factory = sqlite3.Row
    return conn

def init_db():
    conn = get_connection()
    conn.executescript(open('schema.sql').read())
    conn.commit()

def test_borrow_twice_returns_409(client, token):
    client.post('/borrow/1', headers=auth(token))
    r = client.post('/borrow/1', headers=auth(token))
    assert r.status_code == 409
